name: Tenable Nessus
description: Shows what a Tenable Nessus scanner (Nessus Professional, Expert or Essentials) found on your devices: every finding with its severity, CVE numbers, score, whether it is known to be exploited, the port and the solution. Netlens matches each finding to a device by MAC or address, warns about new critical vulnerabilities and lists the devices at risk. Read-only: it only reads scan results, it never starts a scan.
author: Netlens
supports: Tenable Nessus API (from the documentation, not tested on a real Nessus)

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.73 or newer (the Vulnerabilities page). Written from the Nessus API documentation and tested against a simulated server only.
